caption: The drawing depicts a square piece of patterned fabric with a combination of intricate floral and geometric designs. The fabric displays horizontal stripes in alternating colors: light blue, muted red, and soft green. Each stripe is filled with assorted motifs, including large blooming flowers, curling leaves, and stylized ornamental shapes. The colors are interwoven, giving sections of the design a blended appearance where the hues overlap. The fabric's edges are slightly frayed, with loose threads visible along the sides, especially on the bottom and right edges. The background is an off-white or light beige color, separating the fabric from its surroundings. The textile is shown flat, with no visible folds, allowing the full pattern to be clearly observed.
title: U.S. Grant Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
